QA Repo Trajectory Generation Pipeline

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --stage STAGE         Run specific stage(s): N or N-M (e.g., 3 or 3-6)
  --capture-mode {agent,replay}
                        Stage 4-6 behavior: 'agent' (teacher acts in the
                        booted app; default) or 'replay' (legacy instrumented
                        test suites). Also settable via PIPELINE_CAPTURE_MODE.
  --overnight           Run stages 3-6 on all pending repos, notify via
                        Telegram
  --until-limit [PCT]   Loop stages 3-6 until Claude usage reaches PCT% of the
                        subscription limit (bare flag = 100). Honors --budget
                        too.
  --status              Print registry stats and exit
  --requeue-stale       Re-queue rejections from superseded code (per
                        STAGE_BEHAVIOR_CUTOFFS) for a retry
  --requeue-infra       Re-queue infra/flaky rejections
                        (clone/SDK/timeout/max-turns) across stages for a
                        retry
  --requeue-stage REQUEUE_STAGE
                        Re-queue rejections at this stage whose stored gate
                        score >= --min-score (after lowering a threshold)
  --min-score MIN_SCORE
                        Score floor for --requeue-stage (e.g. --requeue-stage
                        4 --min-score 4)
  --prune-unfit         Re-judge repos already past stage 4 and reject obvious
                        bad-fits (toys, boilerplates, login-walled, test-
                        suite-only) so no more stage-5/6 compute is wasted.
                        Reversible via --requeue-stage 4 --min-score 0. Honors
                        --dry-run.
  --dry-run             With --requeue-*: report counts without modifying the
                        registry
  --limit LIMIT         Max repos per stage in this run
  --workers WORKERS     Parallel workers for LLM stages (default: 5)
  --star-floor STAR_FLOOR
                        Stage 1: exhaustively scrape repos down to this star
                        count (default: 5)
  --budget BUDGET       Max total LLM budget for this run in USD (default:
                        50.0)
  --data-dir DATA_DIR   Pipeline data directory
  --traj-dir TRAJ_DIR   Trajectory output directory
  --verbose             Enable debug logging

Examples:
  python -m repo_pipeline.orchestrator --stage 1        # Discover repos
  python -m repo_pipeline.orchestrator --stage 2        # Filter repos
  python -m repo_pipeline.orchestrator --stage 3-7      # Run Claude stages (capture + think)
  python -m repo_pipeline.orchestrator --stage 7        # Fill think blocks for captured repos
  python -m repo_pipeline.orchestrator --overnight       # Full overnight run
  python -m repo_pipeline.orchestrator --until-limit 75  # Drain funnel until 75% usage
  python -m repo_pipeline.orchestrator --status          # Print stats
